info.name: BookingSys Backend
info.description:
API collection for the Booking System backend.

## Auth (`/api/auth`)
| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| POST | /signup, /login | Returns accessToken + refreshToken |
| POST | /refresh | New access token from refreshToken |
| POST | /logout | Blacklist access token, revoke refresh |
| GET/PATCH | /me | Profile read / update |

## Bookings (`/api/bookings`)
| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| POST | / | Create booking |
| GET | /me, /:id | User bookings |
| PATCH | /:id | Change seats (before showtime) |
| DELETE | /:id | Cancel (soft-delete, refund pending) |

## Admin (`/api/admin`)
Theatres, screens, users, bookings, reports (revenue, occupancy, bookings)

## Movies & Showtimes
User: GET movies/showtimes · Admin: POST/PATCH/DELETE at `/api/movies`, `/api/showtimes`

## Setup
1. Import collection + environment
2. Run **Quick Start** or **Admin → Quick Start**
3. Use **Auth → Refresh Token** when access token expires (15 min)

## Variables
`token` (= accessToken), `refreshToken`, `userId`, `targetUserId`, `movieId`, `theatreId`, `hallId`, `showtimeId`, `seatId`, `bookingId`
